metadata.name: generic_research_cost_model_example
metadata.purpose: Versioned research-only template for offline estimated net returns.
notes: Values are generic placeholders and should not be treated as accurate for any broker.
Verify point_size, fallback_spread_points, slippage, and commissions against the exact exported symbol before relying on net results.
Keep broker-specific overrides in ignored local files such as config/cost_model.local.json or config/brokers/<name>.json.
